title: Amanda
creator: CrossFit
description: 9-7-5 reps of muscle-ups and squat snatches at 135/95 lb. Named after Amanda Miller and made famous at the 2010 CrossFit Games; only 42 reps, but two of the highest-skill movements in the sport. Scale with a lighter bar and pull-up-plus-dip substitutions for the muscle-ups.
